correctness.rationale: The two agreeing hub states produce the Boolean radius-1 erosion E and dilation D; E^2(x)=x forces E(x)=x and only unanimous fixed points survive. Opposite equal-hub switching requires D(E(x))=x, equivalent to all one-runs length >=3, plus two exact global hub-vote inequalities; compositions with r marked runs give S_n. Disagreeing hubs can switch only for even n with balanced rim; the ternary cyclic majority map G admits periodic words only with all runs >=2 or perfect alternation. Those contribute B_n+2 for each hub orientation. Explicit run constructions prove even/odd existence boundaries and the independent 5-bit blocks prove the exponential subsequence. Read the complete RESULT.md proof and both source verification scripts. Independently simulated all 2^{n+2} labelled configurations for each n=3..11; fixed=2 and primitive counts 0,20,0,28,0,52,36,184,132. Small enumeration is supplementary.
